name: Lodestar
abilities: Magnetokinesis - generates and controls magnetic fields (half-mile pulse at full power)
Magno-telekinesis over metal; magnetises other objects
Magnetic dismantling (ripped open the Naljian Destructor, tore apart Techadon robots and the Toltech armour)
Electromagnetic force fields (blocks solar energy attacks)
Reconstitution - pulls his shattered pieces back together
Enhanced strength and durability; space survivability
Electromagnetic radar vision; acts as a compass
weaknesses: Useless against non-magnetic materials (pavement, the Stalker, ceramic knives)
Floating unattached head is an easy target - grabbing or striking it drags or spins his body
Magnetic fields can be absorbed/redirected by the Shock Staff
summary: A living-metal magnet man whose head floats between his shoulders; he tears machines apart with magnetism and can rebuild himself from scraps.
traits: Head floats detached in a glowing aura
Unlocked when the Omnitrix reset in War of the Worlds: Part 2
notableFeats: Subdued the red troops in his debut (Simple)
Ripped open the Naljian Destructor (Busy Box)
Survived Aggregor's ship exploding and reassembled himself (Ultimate Aggregor)
Destroyed a mechanical dragon with Kevin (The Purge)
Battled Rex Salazar with magnetism (Ben 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United)

appearances.designNotes: Brownish-black body with yellow feet, hands, shoulders and chest, crab-claw hands, skull-like metal head floating in a white aura; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest; Heroes United used slightly darker yellows.
Yellow brow crest on a more skull-shaped head, green head aura, yellow extends up to thighs, larger shoulders, shorter chest stripes; Omnitrix on chest.

scoring.rationale: Magnetism (special 7) shreds robots, armour and ships from a distance and can rebuild his own shattered body; EM shields block energy. Modest brawler whose powers do nothing against stone or rubber, and his floating head is a glaring target.

notes: All AF uses are wiki AF Season 2 (Vengeance of Vilgax onward) so usedBy is ben-16-af only.
Also used by Vilgax's Bioids (The Final Battle: Part 2).
Heroes United (UA-era) transformation folded into UA appearance.
